sentences.en: I successfully persuaded her and we went on a date.
sentences.zh: 我成功地说服了她，我们出去约会了。

sentences.en: He was extremely happy at having successfully solved the problem.
sentences.zh: 他很高兴自己成功地解决了这个问题。

sentences.en: You only have one life. Live it happily and successfully.
sentences.zh: 你只有一生。快乐而成功地生活吧。
